basics.name: Amir Ali Jiwani
basics.label: Lead / Staff Engineer — Platform, Identity & Distributed Systems
basics.summary: Lead/Staff Engineer with 12+ years building cloud-native platform and identity systems. Expert in designing scalable authentication, observability and distributed services (Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, Kubernetes). Proven track record modernising legacy systems, building multi-language SDKs, and delivering platforms used across product portfolios at scale (millions of users, billions of requests/month).

work.summary: Technical lead on SEEK's identity and marketplace platform. Led architecture, SDKs, migrations and observability to deliver secure, reliable authentication across product teams.
highlights: Led design and delivery of a single identity platform and Auth0 migration serving ~11M MAU and ~2B requests/month; unified SeekPass into Seek, increasing shared user data by 93% and eliminating ~97% duplicate MAUs.
Built multi-language identity SDKs and authentication integrations adopted across all product teams, removing repeated login flows and reducing integration effort.
Re-architected legacy auth components into observable, containerised services (Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, Kubernetes), improving maintainability and lowering incident surface.
Designed and shipped an impersonation-audit logger SDK; surfaced 8 high-risk cases and enabled SteerCo-prioritised remediation.
Led bulk migration strategies and zero-downtime vendor cutovers to ensure consistent authentication behaviour across products.
Improved telemetry and monitoring (AWS ECS alerts, structured tracing) to detect 5xx spikes earlier and reduce customer impact.

work.summary: Platform work for PureVPN and cross-product authentication, developer tooling and legacy decommissioning.
highlights: Enabled PureVPN backbone and cross-product authentication flows for ~1M users and 6.5k+ servers across 78 countries; implemented vendor-based OAuth to support multi-device journeys.
Built cross-platform POCs (React / Flutter) and platform SDKs to accelerate client rollouts.
Led legacy decommissioning to enable server upgrades and security hardening, achieving full server compliance.
Delivered developer tooling and observability practices that reduced repeat failures and improved incident RCA.

work.summary: Delivered mobile POCs, developer tooling and cloud-native patterns to modernise legacy ERP client experiences.
highlights: Delivered a React Native POC and reusable component library enabling mobile demos for ~15k business customers; reduced demo prep and accelerated sales validation.
Built 'BornAgainCarnotauras' (Electron) tooling to streamline API authentication/testing and improve developer productivity.
Introduced CI/CD and cloud-native patterns on Azure with .NET Core services to prove a migration path for legacy systems.
Created navigation and UI abstractions enabling parallel feature streams and increased sprint throughput.

work.summary: Founded a cross-platform studio building apps, games and reusable frameworks; led engineering growth and client engagements.
highlights: Built cross-platform apps and games (FeedGarfield, CandyPot, LongRangeGolf) reaching ~0.5–1M users; created a Cocos2d-based framework reused across 10+ games.
Built a web-scraping → API platform (ASP.NET) used by 50+ clients to power Windows 8 launch apps (CNA, The Straits Times, DBS).
Open-sourced developer libraries (EasyNDK-for-cocos2dx, Easy-CURL-for-PHP) used by the community.

work.summary: Condensed summary for shorter tenures (PicklesAuctions, Agoda, short engagements). Focused on architecture, team formation and platform initiatives.
highlights: Led architecture and platform initiatives, team formation and migrations across short-term leadership engagements.
